profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
My current interests lie in software engineering. I'm on a development team where I write software for amazon prime upsells in the shopping app. I participate in weekly dev meetings and we review sprint tasks to plan our future work. I meet with our developers and project managers weekly listening to their requests creating JIRA tasks accordingly.

For my own self growth, I am a member of toastmasters and the IEEE vice chair of the computer society in Richland, WA. After work, I enjoy building rust console applications and nodejs applications for fun. https://github.com/zeaktorres

Technologies: Node / HTML / C++ / Python / Java / Rust / C# / JavaScript / CSS / SQL / C

positions.title: Software Development Engineer (Remote)
positions.description:
Developed microservices in a Java pkg, WDPS, for the prime team that provides valuable information for prime payment widgets which allow the user to sign up. Managed the CI/CD for the microservices and developed CDK alarm and test packages to verify the customer experience was not impacted. Reduced number of security risks from 30 to 0.

Wrote telemetry in JavaScript for the OOBE (out of the box experience) fire tablet team. Worked directly with the sister team to obtain deadlines, requirements, and expectations. Wrote design documents and responded to feedback.

Developed on a prime upsell injectable which keeps user context while signing up for prime. Increases customer cx as the user is able to freely sign up for prime and continue shopping on the Amazon website. 

Oncall where I actively respond to tickets and contribute to OE (operational excellence). First line of defense when amazon.com/prime upsells/payments are not working and customer experience is impacted.

Customer obsession is my top priority at Amazon. I verify customers are always able to sign up and have a straightforward experience when signing up to become a prime member

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
C++ QT Desktop Application for Field Researchers:
Designed, implemented, and tested complex batch analysis tool to save researcher time by analyzing chemical detectors simultaneously. Involved optimization via multithreading and leveraging storage efficient data structures. Decreased average time to accomplish weekly analysis by 83%.
Persuaded team to move incrementally towards test driven development by demonstrating its capabilities in bug-catching and productivity. Introduced new testing design patterns to make tests more readable. Reduced developer testing time by 90% by refactoring testing library to allow for more granular testing.

Android Plugin for National Security Research:
Launched Android plugin that combines LIDAR drone images with location data to be displayed via NASA WorldWind. Required designing network interface between computer and phone via Robotic Operating System messages. Collaborated with sister national laboratory to accurately define drone data formats.
Massively increased efficiency as users now view relevant field data on live map which automatically updates every thirty seconds via plugin. Previously users would manually construct and upload images.
Mentored team of three interns on development of Android applications and plugins. Authored robust documentation on complicated developer environment setup for future work on application.

Python Library for Advanced Wireless Communications Laboratory:
Developed library to control robot movement. Designed simple interface for researchers to utilize.

React & Node Web Application for Simulating Valve Systems:
Spearheaded design and development of website with React front-end for interacting with back-end simulation service in C++. Created Node middleware utilizing socket.io library for client/server network communications to receive and send live updates from simulation service. Intended for classroom use.
